sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def mk(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')
def glyph(A,r0,c0): return tuple(tuple(1 if A[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def T(p):
    n=5; rots=[p]
    for _ in range(3):
        p=tuple(tuple(p[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(n)); rots.append(p)
    m=tuple(tuple(reversed(r)) for r in p); ms=[m]
    for _ in range(3):
        m=tuple(tuple(m[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(n)); ms.append(m)
    return rots+ms
def match(g,set_): return [(i,t) for i,q in enumerate(set_) for t,tt in enumerate(T(q)) if tt==g]
def show(g): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in r) for r in g)
curA=mk(current_frame); origA=mk(transitions[1].before_frame)
topP=[glyph(curA,r,c) for r in (5,14,23) for c in (23,46)]
Sbar=[glyph(curA,41,c) for c in (15,22,29,36,43)]
P0=[glyph(origA,52,c) for c in (15,22,29,36,43)]
Pn=[glyph(curA,52,c) for c in (15,22,29,36,43)]
print("orig Pbar is transform of same-col Sbar:", [bool(match(g,[Sbar[i]])[0] if False else match(g,[Sbar[i]])) for i,g in enumerate(P0)])
print("now  Pbar is transform of same-col Sbar:", [bool(match(g,[Sbar[i]])) for i,g in enumerate(Pn)])
print("Pbar_orig col3:"); print(show(P0[3]))
print("Sbar col3:"); print(show(Sbar[3]))
# probe dial at col0: DOWN, DOWN, UP
import copy
seq=[]
for act in ['DOWN','DOWN','UP']:
    action([act])
    A=mk(current_frame)
    g=glyph(A,52,15)
    seq.append(match(g,topP))
    print("after",act,"Pbar0 matches:",seq[-1])
print("final Pbar0:"); print(show(glyph(mk(current_frame),52,15)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
